Fidia ya ajali na magonjwa ya kazini hulipwa na WCF (mwajiri huchangia 0.5% ya mishahara). Usajili wa OSHA na wa WCF ni tofauti; vyote vinahitajika. rows.question: nimefanya kazi ya ushauri kwa taasisi ya serikali wamesema watakata vat je asilimia ngapi na cheti nitapata lini
forced_facts: vat withholding services: VAT withholding on services is 6% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 6% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 12% (the statute states this 12% expressly).

vat withholding certificate timing: VAT withholding certificate must be issued NOT LATER THAN the date on which VAT becomes payable under section 15 of the VAT Act — NOT on the 20th of the following month. The 20th deadline applies to filing the VAT return and remitting the withheld amount, which are separate obligations. A withholding agent must issue the certificate in an approved system format containing: TIN, registration number, supply description, consideration amount, withholding rate and withholding amount.
rows.why: VAT withholding services 6% + certificate timing — SS8 row
